evals.name: choose-for-small-project
evals.prompt: This small single-instance Node API needs background jobs. We already use Postgres and want to avoid another service. Compare a Postgres-backed queue, Redis/BullMQ, and a hosted queue, then recommend one with a validation step and tell me whether it needs an ADR.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the stated constraints, compares viable options, recommends one proportionate choice, states tradeoffs and evidence to verify, and recommends an ADR because the dependency choice is sticky.
assertions: The recommendation explicitly uses the single-instance, existing-Postgres, and avoid-another-service constraints
At least two viable alternatives and their rejection reasons are stated
A validation step has a concrete pass/fail outcome
The response distinguishes current facts that need checking from reasoning

evals.name: challenge-novelty
evals.prompt: Everyone on the team is excited about a new database that launched this year. Should we replace our stable Postgres setup before we scale? We have no workload benchmark yet.
evals.expected_output: Does not recommend replacement from novelty alone; asks or identifies missing requirements and proposes a time-boxed representative benchmark/spike with decision criteria.
assertions: The response does not treat newness or popularity as sufficient evidence
The proposed spike uses a representative workload and names what result would change the decision
Operational, migration, and maintenance risks are considered

evals.name: inspect-before-choice
evals.prompt: Pick an auth library for this repository and wire it in. You can choose whatever is best.
evals.expected_output: Inspects project manifests, existing auth/session conventions, deployment and requirements before choosing; if context is unavailable, asks focused questions rather than guessing.
assertions: The response identifies repository evidence it needs before choosing
The response does not present an unqualified library choice from generic popularity
Security, migration, and lock-in are part of the comparison
